findings.claim: ADR-029 §h says the history.jsonl lines for the two recording runs carry the new keys, but neither line is in the PR — evals/report/history.jsonl is untouched by both commits and HEAD's file has no 20260823-002950/003020 entries, so the 'time series' half of the metric record is unverifiable from the commit.
findings.evidence: specs/decisions/ADR-029-structured-tables-annotation.md §h ('The history.jsonl lines for both runs carry the two new keys'); `git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat` lists no history.jsonl; `git show HEAD:evals/report/history.jsonl | grep 20260823` is empty. The runner mechanism itself is fine (my own fast run appended a line with table_cells_fidelity 1.0 / table_rows_fidelity 1.0; invariant line has null).
findings.acceptance: Either the two history lines ride the next consolidated commit (as prior pr-loop commits did), or §h says the lines exist only in the working tree that made the move.

findings.claim: `envelope_shape`'s `_tables_shape` accepts records out of document order and cells outside their table's span, although specs/001 says 'every cell inside its table's span … document order … `envelope_shape` refuses any other shape'; only `tables_sane` catches those two.
findings.evidence: src/sec10k/eval_adapter.py `_tables_shape` (no order check, no cell-within-[start,end] check). Synthetic envelope with tables=[{start:4,end:7,rows:[[[4,5]]]},{start:0,end:7,rows:[[[0,1]]]}] -> envelope_shape None, tables_sane 'table 1 out of document order'; record end:3 with cell [4,5] -> envelope_shape None, tables_sane 'cell [4, 5] outside its table'. Every committed table case runs both checks, so nothing is uncovered today.
findings.repro: python3 -c "from src.sec10k.eval_adapter import eval_check; ..." with the two envelopes above
findings.acceptance: Either `_tables_shape` also asserts order + cell-in-span, or the contract sentence is narrowed to 'shape; order and containment are asserted by `tables_sane`'.
